name: ICANotes
short_description: Behavioral health EHR featuring a 75,000+ phrase content engine for rapid, comprehensive clinical documentation and audit-ready notes.
long_description: ICANotes is a behavioral health EHR developed by a practicing psychiatrist and one of the longest-running platforms in the mental health EHR market. Founded in 1999 in Annapolis, Maryland by brothers Ira and Don Morgenstern, ICANotes serves therapists, psychologists, psychiatrists, and social workers. The platform's distinctive feature is its 75,000+ phrase content engine that enables clinicians to produce comprehensive, audit-ready documentation in a fraction of the time required by free-text or template-based systems. ICANotes offers practice management, telehealth, e-prescribing with EPCS for controlled substances, client portal, and billing capabilities. The platform provides flexible pricing based on clinical role, so prescribing and non-prescribing clinicians pay different rates. In January 2026, Sheridan Capital Partners completed an investment in ICANotes.
one_liner: Behavioral health EHR with the industry's largest clinical phrase library for rapid documentation.
best_for: Clinicians who want to dramatically reduce documentation time
Psychiatrists needing e-prescribing with EPCS capabilities
Practices wanting audit-ready, comprehensive clinical notes
Mental health providers tired of free-text or basic templates
not_for: Addiction treatment centers needing specialized SUD features

pricing.notes: Role-based pricing: Part-Time Notes Only $35/mo, Part-Time Non-Prescribing $45/mo, Full-Time Notes Only $55/mo, Full-Time Non-Prescribing $75/mo, Part-Time Prescribing $138/mo, Full-Time Prescribing $213/mo. No setup fee for non-prescribers. One-time activation fee for prescribers due to e-Prescribing configuration.

faqs.q: How much does ICANotes cost per month?
faqs.a: ICANotes uses role-based pricing. Part-time therapists start at $35/month (notes only) or $45/month (full features). Full-time non-prescribing clinicians pay $55-$75/month. Prescribers pay $138/month (part-time) or $213/month (full-time) which includes e-prescribing.

faqs.q: What is ICANotes' phrase content engine?
faqs.a: ICANotes features a unique 75,000+ phrase content engine that allows clinicians to build comprehensive, audit-ready clinical notes by selecting from pre-written clinical phrases rather than free-text typing. This dramatically reduces documentation time.

faqs.q: Does ICANotes include e-prescribing for controlled substances?
faqs.a: Yes, ICANotes offers e-prescribing with EPCS (Electronic Prescribing for Controlled Substances) for prescribing clinicians. The prescribing plans ($138-$213/month) include this capability.

ICANotes was founded in 1999 in Annapolis, Maryland by brothers Ira and Don Morgenstern. Ira Morgenstern is a practicing psychiatrist who developed the system to address documentation challenges. The company remains family-led today.
